title: podocarpus oleifolius subsp. costaricensis
intro: Podocarpus oleifolius subsp. costaricensis, commonly known as Costa Rican Podocarpus, is a plant species within the coniferous genus Podocarpus, belonging to the Podocarpaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the relief of respiratory issues, fever reduction, and wound healing. The health benefits of Podocarpus oleifolius subsp. costaricensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and the treatment of various infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and other compounds with potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
